_comment: Verification pass of 2026-08-16 against Form ON428 (5006-C) and Worksheet
ON428 (5006-D). Four values were wrong, and THREE CREDITS HAD THE WRONG
SHAPE: Ontario reduces a base amount by the dependant's income and then caps
the result. The previous model had no base/maximum distinction at all.
Still unverified: the CARE credit parameters (Schedule ON479-A) and the
NOT MODELLED AT ALL, and found during this pass: the Ontario health premium
(ON428 line 89), which ADDS to Ontario tax, and the Ontario tax reduction
(lines 74-80), which subtracts from it. Ontario tax is wrong for most filers

care_rate_base_tier1.source: Schedule ON479-A: 75% of the federal child care deduction for family income up to $20,000.

care_tier1_ceiling.source: Schedule ON479-A: the full 75% rate applies up to $20,000 of family income.

care_rate_base_tier2.source: Schedule ON479-A: the second tier also starts at 75%, reduced by 2% for each $2,500 (or part) of income above $20,000.

care_tier2_ceiling.source: Schedule ON479-A: second tier runs to $40,000.

care_tier2_step.source: Schedule ON479-A: $2,500 income step in the second tier, counting each part-step as a whole one.

care_rate_base_tier3.source: Schedule ON479-A: 59% base for the $40,000-$60,000 tier. Corroborated by Ontario's own worked example: at $45,500 the rate is 55%, which is 59% - 2% x ceil(5500/5000) = 59% - 4%.

care_tier3_ceiling.source: Schedule ON479-A: third tier runs to $60,000.

care_tier3_step.source: Schedule ON479-A: $5,000 income step in the third tier. Confirmed by Ontario's worked example at $45,500.

care_rate_base_tier4.source: Schedule ON479-A: 51% base for the $60,000-$150,000 tier, reduced by 2% for each $3,600 (or part) above $60,000, reaching zero at $150,000.

care_tier4_ceiling.source: Schedule ON479-A: the credit reaches zero at $150,000 of family income.

care_tier4_step.source: Schedule ON479-A: $3,600 income step in the fourth tier, which takes 51% to zero across the $60,000-$150,000 range in 25 steps.

care_step_reduction.source: Schedule ON479-A: every step reduces the rate by 2 percentage points.
